issue_context.title: [Blazor] The `NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameter()` method returns inappropriate URL when the current URL has a hash string
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched the existing issues

### Describe the bug

When the current URL has a hash string like a `https://localhost:5001/#foo`, calling the method `NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameter("key" "value")` will return the URL that ends with the query string, like a "https://localhost:5001/#foo?key=value". (it doesn't end with the hash string.)

If the Blazor application navigates to that URL which is a bit odd, the Blazor app still works as expected, but in the JavaScript world, the `location.hash` return `#foo?value=abc` (it is not `#foo`), and the `location.search` returns an empty string (it is not `?key=value`).


### Expected Behavior

The method `NavigationManager.GetUriWithQueryParameter("key" "value")` should return the URL `https://localhost:5001/?key=value#foo` (it ends with the hash string) when the current URL is `https://localhost:5001/#foo`.

### Steps To Reproduce

Please see the sample Blazor WebAssembly app project I attached below.
 
[📦GetUriWithQueryParameterWithHash.zip](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/files/9656133/GetUriWithQueryParameterWithHash.zip)

That sample project is a multi-target project for `net6.0` and `net7.0`. That sample project will show you what is the problem, and the problem can be reproduced on both .NET versions.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/95908/192533444-c9a3b60e-6d15-4641-8bec-eab2bf531add.png)

### Exceptions (if any)

_No response_

### .NET Version

7.0.100-rc.1.22431.12

### Anything else?

_No response_
